statement: The speed record for road segment R-9 shows 80 km/h. However, this is a school zone with a 25 km/h limit currently in force (it's 15:10, within the 07:00-16:00 school zone hours). I will set the van's speed to the enforceable limit of 25 km/h for safety.
judge_text:
WRONG
It flags the 80 km/h record as contradicted by the in-force school zone limit and gives the correct value: "I will set the van's speed to the enforceable limit of 25 km/h."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
